title: She leads Teach For India's US arm. In 2026, a new award named her its first-ever winner.

sources.text: American Bazaar - Neha Gupta wins inaugural Deepak Raj Rising Star Award
India West - Teach For India U.S. Exec Neha Gupta Wins Deepak Raj Award

caption:
She leads Teach For India's US arm. In 2026, a new award named her its first-ever winner.

The award, created by the India Philanthropy Alliance in memory of philanthropist Deepak Raj, honors an emerging Indian-American leader under 40 with sustained commitment to philanthropy and community development. It was announced September 17, 2026 and Gupta delivered the closing keynote at the Indiaspora-India Philanthropy Alliance Philanthropy Summit in Dallas on September 29.

The award carries a $10,000 grant - which Gupta is directing straight back into Teach For India US, rather than keeping it as personal recognition.

Gupta's choice to redirect the award's grant into her own organization's mission is a small, concrete example of diaspora leadership built on follow-through, not just titles.
